system.description: You feel at home in natural environments and wish to see them cared for, even those of other worlds. Perhaps you've witnessed the devastation that can be wrought on a planet by the Jaffa, or you might simply feel driven to protect the natural splendor on display in the Milky Way.
system.bonus: Bonus Proficiency: Nature. An Eye for Nature: You gain advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom Checks to identify the properties of plants.
